subject.why: It is clearly a twisting beanstalk with leaves and golden beans hanging from it.

category.why: The ground is rendered as a cross-section slice with scattered pebbles and baby sprouts rather than a clean, natural ground plane in perspective like the references.

clean.why: No text, logos, UI, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: The beanstalk is centrally placed with comfortable margins on the top and sides, anchored at the bottom.

colour.why: Vibrant greens and yellows set against a bright, saturated blue sky.

detail.why: The base features scattered clutter including tiny stones, patches, and miniature sprouts along the soil line.

style.why: Features chunky, smooth volumes and a soft satin finish consistent with the game style.

fix: Remove the scattered pebbles and mini sprouts along the ground, and replace the cutaway soil edge with a clean, smooth strip of grassy ground receding into the distance.
